subject: Request: daily observability digest + owner pingbacks for per-route economics
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: acme-data@acme-retail.com, partners+telemetry@infra-partner.com
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: daily observability digest + owner pingbacks for per-route economics

Hi team —

Short ask: Acme (cc'd) has asked for a simple daily email that summarizes their key per-route economics and a lightweight "owner pingback" feature so route owners get notified when a route exceeds a spend or latency threshold. This would help account execs and SREs surface regressions quickly without opening the Console.

What I want to capture in the digest (first pass):
- Top 5 routes by 24h spend (token + infra estimate)
- 95th/99th tail latency per route (with historical delta)
- Any route with spend > X% of daily budget or latency > SLO
- Owner contact and a single-click link to create a playbook incident in PagerDuty/Slack

Constraints and priorities: this must be light-weight (no heavy-querying each morning), and owners need a way to opt-in/out per route. Ideally: daily at 06:00 UTC, digest sent to route owner(s) + account exec.

Attachments: wireframe for a one-email digest (daily_digest_wireframe.png) + a sample owner mapping CSV schema (owner_mapping_sample.csv).

Questions for the group:
1) Marissa — can Console product add a scheduled digest job and lightweight template?
2) Rishi — what indexing/aggregation do you need on ingestion to make this 06:00 UTC job cheap? Any risk to control plane?
3) Lauren — will Sales want this pushed to customers or gated? Pricing/entitlement considerations?

I propose a quick sync Wed AM to scope MVP (digest + pingback). If acceptable, we'll scope a 2-sprint beta for a small set of accounts (Acme, Nimbus) and include it in the weekly roadmap.

Thanks,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Head of Product — Observability
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: acme-data@acme-retail.com, partners+telemetry@infra-partner.com
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: daily observability digest + owner pingbacks for per-route economics

Thanks Grace — I like the idea and the wireframe is helpful. A few quick clarifying points from product/console side:

- We already have a daily reporting job that computes aggregate spend per account; adding a per-route rollup increases cardinality and storage. We should limit the digest to a fixed top-N routes or routes tagged as "customer-facing".
- The template should be modular: metric tiles + quick action links. Quick-action could point to a Console deep link that opens a "synthesize incident" modal.
- Opt-in model: route owners can be pulled from an owner map (CSV) and can set "digest preferences" via account settings in Console. Default should be ON for routes with assigned owners, OFF otherwise.

Action items I can take before the Wed sync:
- Draft the digest email template and the Console deep-link payload (notion: https://redwood.notion.site/OBS-Digest-Ownership-Playbook-7a2b).
- Work with UX to add a compact "digest preferences" toggle in route settings.

Open question: are we okay with a daily asynchronous baked email (no immediate SLA), or do we need near-real-time owner pingbacks for critical thresholds? If the latter, that'll be a different scope (streaming alerts).

—Marissa
Product Manager, Console
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: acme-data@acme-retail.com, partners+telemetry@infra-partner.com
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: daily observability digest + owner pingbacks for per-route economics

Quick technical read — thanks for the clear ask. From an infra/ingest perspective:

- Cost attribution per route is feasible but we need to decide the attribution model: per-request token accounting (accurate) vs. sampled/estimate model (cheap). For daily digest, an estimate model using pre-aggregated token counts + amortized infra cost per GPU-hour should be fine.
- To keep the 06:00 UTC job cheap: maintain a daily rollup table keyed by (account, route_id, day) that we update incrementally during normal ingest windows. We already compute account daily sums; adding route_id increases writes ~N_routes * requests but the write amplification is manageable if we only persist high-volume routes or top-N.
- Owner pingbacks: implement as an event generated by the rollup comparator (if today's spend > threshold OR latency SLO breached). The event can push a webhook, email, or a Console notification. We should support both: email digest + optional webhook for teams that want to integrate into their Incident system.

Risks/notes:
- If we allow arbitrary historical queries for the digest, it could blow up costs. For MVP, limit lookback to 7 days and top-5 routes.
- We'll need a small schema change to the route metadata to store owner_id(s) and preferred notification channel. owner_mapping_sample.csv is a good start.

I'll prototype the incremental rollup service and a small API that returns the digest payload within one sprint. If Marissa can provide the template by Wed, we can align the API shape to the template.

—Rishi
Engineering Lead — Telemetry & Runtime Economics
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: acme-data@acme-retail.com, partners+telemetry@infra-partner.com
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: daily observability digest + owner pingbacks for per-route economics

Thanks all — this is great. Quick decisions so we can move to scoping:

1) MVP scope (1st release): daily digest at 06:00 UTC for top-5 routes per account + owner pingback event if thresholds breached. 7-day lookback in digest.
2) Attribution model: use Rishi's estimate-based rollup (incremental route-day table). We'll refine exact cost formula in sprint 1.
3) Opt-in: default ON for routes with owner_id present; owners may toggle via Console. Marissa to add toggle and email template.
4) Delivery: email digest + optional webhook. Partners (cc'd) can subscribe to webhook for integration.

Owners and next steps:
- Marissa: draft email template + Console toggle mock by Wed 10/13. Add deep-link payload.
- Rishi: spike on incremental rollup + digest API; aim for a demo by 10/20.
- Lauren: draft sales messaging and entitlement constraints; confirm whether this is part of current entitlement tiers by 10/15.
- Grace: coordinate pilot with Acme and Partners; will prepare acceptance criteria.

I'll create the HubSpot task (HUBSPOT-123456) and a Notion page for sprint tracking. If no objections, I'll add this to the Observability board next backlog grooming.

Thanks — let's keep threads short on implementation and use the Notion doc for detailed specs.

Grace
